description: MAS Financial Services Limited, a non-banking finance company (NBFC), provides retail financing services for individuals and businesses in India. It operates through Financing Activities and Others segments. The company offers micro-enterprise, small and medium enterprise, business, two-wheeler, used car, salaried personal, commercial vehicle and property, and housing finance loans; project loans for real estate projects; loans to NBFCs; and loans against property. It also engages in insurance broking activities. MAS Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
